  • Method Details

    • run

      public ReportRepository.ReportTable run(ReportRepository.Report report) throws IOException, SQLException
      Executes an allowlisted report that does not require a date range.
      Parameters:
      report - report to run; PRODUCT_USAGE requires the date-range overload
      Returns:
      the report labels and result rows
      Throws:
      IOException - if settings or a packaged query cannot be read
      SQLException - if query execution fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the report is null or requires dates

    • run

      public ReportRepository.ReportTable run(ReportRepository.Report report, LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) throws IOException, SQLException
      Executes an allowlisted report in a read-only transaction. For product usage, both endpoints are included using recorded database order dates. Recipe usage uses current recipes; later recipe edits can change historical results. Other reports ignore the supplied dates.
      Parameters:
      report - report to run
      startDate - inclusive first product-usage date; ignored for other reports
      endDate - inclusive last product-usage date; ignored for other reports
      Returns:
      column labels and rows from the query
      Throws:
      IOException - if settings or a packaged query cannot be read
      SQLException - if query execution fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the report is null or product-usage dates are missing or reversed

    • salesByItem

      public ReportRepository.SalesReport salesByItem(LocalDate from, LocalDate to) throws IOException, SQLException
      Reports completed-order item sales from the start of from through the end of to. Dates are bound as parameters, and revenues use saved sale prices rather than current menu prices.
      Parameters:
      from - inclusive first sales date
      to - inclusive last sales date
      Returns:
      item sales ordered by combined drink and topping revenue
      Throws:
      IOException - if settings or the packaged query cannot be read
      SQLException - if the query fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if either date is null or the range is reversed

    • runXReport

      public ReportRepository.XReportSummary runXReport() throws IOException, SQLException
      Runs the non-closing X-report for today according to the application's local clock.
      Returns:
      today's daily totals and hourly breakdown
      Throws:
      IOException - if settings or the packaged query cannot be read
      SQLException - if the query fails or returns no summary

    • runXReport

      public ReportRepository.XReportSummary runXReport(LocalDate selectedDate) throws IOException, SQLException
      Runs the X-report for a selected business date without resetting or closing the register.
      Parameters:
      selectedDate - business date to summarize
      Returns:
      daily totals and all 24 hourly sales rows
      Throws:
      IOException - if settings or the packaged query cannot be read
      SQLException - if the query fails or returns no summary
      IllegalArgumentException - if the date is null
